newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Shokubai bid-only on dioxin dissolver.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Shokubai bid-only on dioxin dissolver.

text.p: Shares of Nippon Shokubai Co Ltd were bid-only on Tuesday morning, helped by news on Monday that the firm had developed and would start selling catalysts and facilities which can dissolve over 99 percent of harmful dioxin emissions from garbage incineration plants.
As of 0047 GMT, the shares were bid-only at 889 yen, compared with the Monday close of 869 yen.

A company official told Reuters that the leading Japanese manufacturer of chemical catalysts was aiming for annual sales of three billion yen in the next three years and five billion yen in the next five years for the new products.
Dioxin is a highly toxic by-product of some industrial processes and is known to cause a wide range of diseases, including cancer.
